query.text: 请帮我照看宝宝，如果他摔倒或有危险请及时提醒，并随时告诉我他的最新情况。
query.text_en: Please help me watch the baby, alert me immediately if he falls or is in danger, and keep me updated on his situation at all times.

annotation.text_zh: 宝宝摔倒了，不哭不哭，慢慢扶着站起来。
annotation.text_en: The baby fell down. Don't cry, slowly stand back up.

annotation.text_zh: 宝宝别怕，慢慢坐好，等妈妈过来。
annotation.text_en: Don't be scared, baby. Sit up slowly and wait for mommy.

annotation.text_zh: 宝宝真棒，自己扶着抱枕站起来了。
annotation.text_en: Great job! The baby stood up on their own using the pillow.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
